title: GAP Waiver Addenda Plan Schedule: Prices and Contract Eligibility
content:
GAP Waiver Addenda are sold in six plans. Each plan has its own retail charge, which is financed in the retail installment contract, and its own limits on the contracts that may carry it.

## Schedule by plan

| Plan | Retail charge financed (USD) | Highest loan-to-value at signing | Longest original term | Largest amount financed (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GAP Waiver 120 | 495.00 | 120 percent | 60 months | 25000.00 |
| GAP Waiver 130 | 595.00 | 130 percent | 66 months | 30000.00 |
| GAP Waiver 140 | 695.00 | 140 percent | 72 months | 35000.00 |
| GAP Waiver 150 | 795.00 | 150 percent | 75 months | 45000.00 |
| GAP Waiver Plus 150 | 895.00 | 150 percent | 75 months | 50000.00 |
| GAP Waiver Premier 150 | 995.00 | 150 percent | 75 months | 60000.00 |

## Conditions common to every plan

- **Vehicle age:** the vehicle is no older than 10 years. Age is counted in model years, as the contract year less the model year.
- **Excluded vehicle uses:** a contract is ineligible when the vehicle is in commercial use, is used for rideshare or livery, or carries a salvage or rebuilt title.
- **When it can be bought:** every plan can be bought only at contract signing.

## Reading the schedule

A contract qualifies for a plan only when it meets every column on that plan's row and every common condition: its loan-to-value and original term are within the plan's limits, its amount financed is no more than the plan's largest amount financed, and its vehicle passes both the age and the use tests.

*Hypothetical illustration.* A contract signed with a loan-to-value of 128 percent, a 66-month term, 27500.00 financed and a six-year-old vehicle in personal use is within the limits of GAP Waiver 130 and every higher plan. It is outside GAP Waiver 120, because its loan-to-value, its term and its amount financed all exceed that plan's limits.
